replacement: One lazy persistent Rayon worker per reserved slot; caller participates last. Scoped references replace JobRef lifetime transmute, raw dereference and manual Send.
public_interface: Launcher signatures and bounds unchanged; reservations, busy fallback, release, ordered failure aggregation and sticky caller failure retained.
dependency_trust: Pinned rayon 1.12.0 introduces established third-party unsafe internals. No first-party unsafe implementation moved into a dependency. cargo deny --all-features check and cargo audit passed on the candidate lockfile.
verified_local: Persistent worker physical identity and caller index
4000 concurrent launches with separate borrowed completion counters
Nested borrowed launches from every participant
400 concurrent failing launches return only their own worker error and wait for remaining participants
Nested worker failures are captured by their invocation without poisoning outer jobs or subsequent reuse
Injected Rayon thread-start refusal maps to ProgramError and leaves initialization retryable
Physical worker shutdown waits for thread-local destructor completion
Unused worker shutdown does not initialize an executor
